message: Desk 0.1.40 fixes the Create R/O label missing the car model. When the last name and the model are both on the page, the label now reads {LastName} - {Model} for any make, not just Porsche (BMW, Audi, Toyota, Chevrolet, Mercedes, Tesla and the rest), including models like GLC300, RX350, M340i, Silverado 1500 and Model Y. A license plate, plate state, VIN or account number is still never the model. Every Create R/O prints, and the label layout is unchanged.
chromiumMessage: Click Download update, unzip Black.Forest.Desk-chromium.zip over your Desk folder, then press Reload Desk.
